total 0
#!/bin/sh

function remove_tmp_files() {
	local VLOG_FILE_NAME=$1
	local HW_LOG_FILE_NAME=$2
	
	# Remove the temp files from flash
	CMD="/usr/bin/rm -rf /tmp/media/IRAUSBDrive/$VLOG_FILE_NAME*"
	echo "executing $CMD"
	$CMD
	
	CMD="/usr/bin/rm -rf /tmp/media/IRAUSBDrive/IRAENC_$VLOG_FILE_NAME*"
	echo "executing $CMD"
	$CMD
	
	CMD="/usr/bin/rm -rf /tmp/media/IRAUSBDrive/$HW_LOG_FILE_NAME*"
	echo "executing $CMD"
	$CMD
	
	CMD="/usr/bin/rm -rf /tmp/media/IRAUSBDrive/IRAENC_$HW_LOG_FILE_NAME*"
	echo "executing $CMD"
	$CMD
}

function launch_syspopup() {
    local message=$1
    local timeout=$2
    local align=$3
    
    command="launch_app org.tizen.alert-syspopup type toast text \"$message\" timeout $timeout align $align"
    eval "$command"
}

message="Vlog USB Dump Started"
timeout=3
align="top-right"

launch_syspopup "$message" "$timeout" "$align"


# run vlogutil and save it to tmp path


# Create destination path
/usr/bin/mkdir -p /tmp/media/IRAUSBDrive
FILE=/etc/release

TIME_STAMP=$(date +"%Y_%m%d_%H%M_%S")
HW_LOG_FILE_NAME="HW_log_$TIME_STAMP.hwc"
VLOG_FILE_NAME="vlog_dump_$TIME_STAMP"

if [ $# -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "No command-line arguments provided. Not WOC"
else
    HW_LOG_FILE_NAME="WOC_HW_log_$TIME_STAMP.hwc"
	VLOG_FILE_NAME="WOC_vlog_dump_$TIME_STAMP"
fi

# Check if debug/perf image or release image
if [ -f "$FILE" ]
then
	echo "$FILE exists."

	# REL image - create zip and ecrypt the zip
	/usr/bin/vlogutil -T -z -v hwclock -o /tmp/media/IRAUSBDrive/$VLOG_FILE_NAME
	/usr/bin/cat /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/trace > /tmp/media/IRAUSBDrive/$HW_LOG_FILE_NAME
	
	/bin/sh /opt/etc/ira_encrypt.sh "$VLOG_FILE_NAME.zip" "/tmp/media/IRAUSBDrive"				
	/bin/sh /opt/etc/ira_encrypt.sh "$HW_LOG_FILE_NAME" "/tmp/media/IRAUSBDrive"

else 
	echo "$FILE does not exist."

	# DEBUG/PERF image - create txt file, no encryption
	/usr/bin/vlogutil -T -v hwclock -o /tmp/media/IRAUSBDrive/$VLOG_FILE_NAME
	/usr/bin/cat /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/trace > /tmp/media/IRAUSBDrive/$HW_LOG_FILE_NAME

fi

# Define the maximum number of attempts
MAX_ATTEMPTS=20  # 20 attempts * 3 seconds = 60 seconds (1 minute)

# Function to check if the USB device is mounted
check_usb_mount() {
	USB_MOUNT_POINT=$(lsblk -o MOUNTPOINT | grep USBDrive)
    if [ -z "$USB_MOUNT_POINT" ]; then
        echo "USB device is not mounted."
    else        
		echo "USB device is mounted."
		for USB_PATH in $(echo $USB_MOUNT_POINT)
		do
			SECURE_FILE=$USB_PATH"/dump_vlog_here.txt"
			if [ -f "$SECURE_FILE" ]
			then        
				echo "File present : $SECURE_FILE"
				FILE=/etc/release
				if [ -f "$FILE" ]
				then
					echo "$FILE exists."			
					/usr/bin/cp -rf /tmp/media/IRAUSBDrive/IRAENC_$VLOG_FILE_NAME* $USB_PATH
